metadata.title: ADSS, Aerial and Direct Burial Fiber Cable | Vocom
metadata.description: ADSS all-dielectric self-supporting, figure 8, and armored direct burial fiber cable to 432F, build-to-order for pole spans and trenched routes.

attributes.text: ADSS, Aerial and Direct Burial Fiber Optic Cable

All-dielectric self-supporting cable for long pole spans, figure 8 with integrated messenger, and armored cable for direct burial, in counts to 432F. Sourced build-to-order from tier 1 manufacturers and delivered in 6 to 8 weeks from PO, up to 10 weeks for custom builds.
Need a different spec? We also build to custom order.

attributes.altText: ADSS aerial self-supporting fiber optic cable strung on a pole

attributes.text: This is a route decision before it is a product decision. A long pole span with no messenger available wants ADSS, which carries its own weight and stays all-dielectric so it can run near power without bonding. A shorter span is usually cheaper on figure 8. A trench wants armor. Pick the route first and the cable follows.
ADSS, figure 8, armored direct burial, hybrid fiber and copper
All-dielectric self-supporting, integrated messenger, round armored
UV stable HDPE, rodent resistant armor, water blocking
Aerial self-supporting, aerial lashed, direct burial, tower and FTTA
6 to 8 weeks from PO, up to 10 weeks for custom builds
Span rating and count specified together, because the two constrain each other. Drum lengths quoted per route.
Build-to-order: specified to your route, count and jacket, not off a fixed shelf.
Fujikura preform glass: tier 1 manufacturing, consistent quality.
Lead times that move: supply when domestic loose-tube is quoted months out.
Import/export handled: documentation, customs and delivery coordinated.
Founded in 1998: a supplier that also runs networks.
ADSS and aerial fiber cable FAQ
Any span sharing structure with energized conductors. All-dielectric construction has no metallic element, so there is nothing to bond or ground and nothing to induce onto.

ADSS on long spans where no messenger exists and the cable has to carry itself. Figure 8 on shorter spans, where the integrated messenger is usually the cheaper way to get there. Send the span lengths and the loading class.

Span rating depends on count, jacket and ice or wind loading class, so it is quoted per route rather than published as one number. Give us the longest span on the run and the loading class and we will spec against it.
Do you supply hybrid cable for tower sites?
Yes, two copper and two fiber for FTTA and antenna sites, with IP68 waterproof connectors and terminal boxes in LC and MT types.

Self-supporting aerial cable is fiber cable that carries its own strength member, so it can be hung from poles or towers without a separate messenger wire. ADSS, all-dielectric self-supporting cable, contains no metal, which is why it suits spans that share structure with energized power lines. Vocom supplies ADSS aerial fiber cable build-to-order, with a standard lead time of 6 to 8 weeks.
Need a Fiber Built to Your Exact Specification?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and connector, we can source and build any fiber optic cable to match your spec.
